title: VPN reserved ranges
help: Address ranges used by this domain's VPN tunnels. Creating or changing a subnet is refused when its CIDR or gateway overlaps one of these ranges.
existingHelp: Existing subnets that already overlap are not modified, and renaming or DHCP changes stay allowed. Shared and external networks created by administrators are checked against every domain's reserved ranges.
rangesHelp: Enter one per line. Up to {max} ranges; IPv4 must be /8 or narrower and IPv6 /32 or narrower.
tooMany: You can reserve at most {max} ranges.
emptyWarning: With an empty list, subnets in this domain may overlap VPN tunnel ranges.
loadFailed: Could not load VPN reserved ranges.
conflict: Someone else changed these ranges first. Refresh and try again.
invalid: Enter valid CIDRs only. IPv4 must be /8 or narrower and IPv6 /32 or narrower.
reloadRequired: Refresh to see the current value.
unknownOutcome: The save result could not be confirmed. Refresh to check the current value.
scopeMismatch: A response for a different domain was received and not shown.
